acceptance_condition_being_evidenced: The public suite is frozen and hashed, and holdout cases are authored by a different owner and withheld until scoring. Falsified if the holdout author is the same owner as the generation author.

independence_evidence.evidence: a6's case file declares authored_before_producer_read true and producer_test_hashes_seen_at_authoring [], and its own execution record declares producer_branches_observed []

what_a8_contributed_and_why.contribution: an executable binding from each of a6's declared attacks to the operation vocabulary the generations implement
what_a8_contributed_and_why.necessity: a6 executed six of its ten cases against the seeded result validator and deferred H07 through H10, recording that they require a producer custody engine, a producer lease and fence implementation, a committed remote artifact to attack, and a producer ingestion and recovery implementation. The three generations are custody engines, so all ten of a6's cases become executable and a6's recorded boundary is closed.
what_a8_contributed_and_why.constraint_observed: no attack class, mutation or expected outcome was added, removed or weakened; the binding covers a6's case set exactly and build_holdout_suite.py fails if the coverage is not exact

limitations: The executable encoding of a6's cases is authored by the same owner that authored the generations. Case selection and expected outcomes are independent; the encoding is not. A fully independent holdout would have a6 author executable cases against a published controller contract, which had not happened at scoring time.

a6 published no scored disposition of this cohort's generations at scoring time, so the holdout result recorded here is this cohort's execution of a6's cases and not a6's acceptance of the result. Independent acceptance remains NOT_TESTED.

Cohort po03-worker-a10 (cursor/po03-a10-crossfamily-review-ed20) is the second declared independent evaluator. Its branch did not exist at scoring time, so no cross-family holdout material was available and none was substituted.

The holdout was fetched and bound before G2 was written, but the same owner both read the holdout and authored G2. G2's changes are traceable to specific G1 failures and to a6's recorded findings rather than to holdout cases alone, and lineage.json records which cause drove each change, but this cohort cannot certify blindness to the holdout.

holdout_result_status.applies_to: every holdout figure this cohort reports, including G2's 10/10 and G1's 7/10, and the headline PASS verdict, which is computed on the holdout suite
holdout_result_status.why: The cases, attacks and expected outcomes are cohort a6's and were authored before any producer branch was published. But they were selected from a6's set and bound to executable operations by po03-worker-a8, the same owner that authored the generations being scored. Selection and encoding by the generation author is weaker independence than authorship by a non-author, so a perfect holdout score cannot yet be read as a blind result. Marked provisional here rather than argued away, because a 10/10 on a suite the author assembled is precisely the figure that most deserves the caveat.

pending.design: at least twenty cases authored from the commission's acceptance criteria alone, frozen and pushed before reading anything of this cohort's, so neither selection nor encoding passes through the generation author
pending.closes: the independence gap recorded in limitations[0] and boundary_states.holdout_independence_is_author_selected
pending.supersedes_this_status_when: a13's suite is published and the three generations are scored against it

holdout_result_status.what_would_count_as_the_finding: If G2 scores materially lower on a13's blind suite than the 10/10 recorded here, that is the result, and it is a more honest one than a perfect score on a suite this cohort assembled. Nothing in this cohort's records should be read as predicting otherwise, and no figure here is stated as final on the holdout.
holdout_result_status.unaffected: The public-suite figures are unaffected: that suite was always this cohort's own and is declared as such. The G0-to-G1 NOT_YET finding is likewise unaffected, since it turns on false completions and critical correctness rather than on holdout lift.
